transforms.name: adapter-step-0
transforms.effect: cost_usd is copied when it is a non-negative finite number, including 0. A missing or negative value omits costUsd.

transforms.name: adapter-step-1
transforms.effect: The event does not set cost coverage, burnPerHour, or a series.
